abstract_sentences.text: Diffusion models have transformed image synthesis by establishing unprecedented quality and creativity benchmarks.

evidence.anchor: Diffusion models have transformed image synthesis.

abstract_sentences.text: Nevertheless, their large-scale deployment faces challenges due to computationally intensive iterative denoising processes.

Although post-training quantization (PTQ) provides an effective pathway for accelerating sampling, the iterative nature of diffusion models causes stepwise quantization errors to accumulate progressively during generation, inevitably compromising output fidelity.

To address this challenge, we develop a theoretical framework that mathematically formulates error propagation in Diffusion Models (DMs), deriving per-step quantization error propagation equations and establishing the first closed-form solution for cumulative error.

evidence.anchor: first closed-form solution for cumulative error.

abstract_sentences.text: Building on this theoretical foundation, we propose a timestep-aware cumulative error compensation scheme.
Extensive experiments on multiple image datasets demonstrate that our compensation strategy effectively mitigates error propagation, significantly enhancing existing PTQ methods.

evidence.anchor: Extensive experiments on multiple image datasets.

abstract_sentences.text: Specifically, it achieves a 1.2 PSNR improvement over SVDQuant on SDXL W4A4, while incurring only an additional < 0.5% time overhead.

evidence.anchor: DMs have established themselves as highly effective.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 量化去噪的单步误差会沿迭代轨迹积累；以可近似的递推写出该偏移，再通过校准得到的通道系数在线抵消，可叠加到已有 PTQ 底座以改善质量。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留了误差变量、Eq. (7)/(8)/(18)、量化配置、图像/视频主表和 latency 表，足以支持算法与部署 trade-off 的初读判断。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承载 Jacobian 近似、m=1 条件和比较、DPM++ 推导、λ1、步数与 calibration 敏感性、QNCD 对照及完整视觉结果；这些内容对理论范围判断关键。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 用一个状态递推压缩机制，再让 Figure 1、Table 1/2 和 Table 3 分别承担机制、质量和成本判断，使核心主线可扫读。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 没有命名定理或不确定性报告；少步数边界藏在 Appendix G；「cumulative error 是主因」缺少能隔离该因果机制的独立消融。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 迭代系统误差论文应在正文给出最小递推、可计算 correction 和匹配的质量/成本主表，并显式召回决定近似可信度的条件和敏感性。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 若系统没有可观测递推状态、只执行一次前向推理，或精确递推不是能力来源，就不应强行组织为 closed-form error narrative。
